document.title: RALEIGHLIGHTS PORTFOLIO TEST
instructions: Look at the ads as you would normally when reading a magazine, spending as much or as little time on each as you would like.
When the respondent is finished, take back the portfolio and ask them to recall all the ads they remember.
Give me the complete name of each ad as you remember it from the ad.

questions.Qu.1a: What other ads do you remember?
questions.Qu.1c: Do you remember seeing an advertisement for --BRAND?
